tasks.title: Amendment proposal path: target kind, host validation, widening classifier, durable record
tasks.objective: Add request_access target kind capability_template_amendment (capabilityId, proposedTemplates 1..8, observedArgv) flowing runner->IPC->host. Host branch validates against the CATALOG only: local-cli template validator + single-leaf parseBashCommand, then a pure conservative prefix-based widening classifier. Durable proposal table (migration) with unique canonical key; deny terminal across restarts. capability_run invalid_args text points to the proposal path.
acceptance_criteria: Proposal target kind reaches the host with trusted routing; agent-supplied current-template/executable copies are ignored (catalog is authority)
Invalid proposed templates (shell metachars, redirects, wrong executable prefix, multi-leaf) are rejected before any card

Widening classifier: same executable + identical literal executable+subcommand prefix + only added trailing positional slots = non-widening; everything else widening; unsure = widening (table-driven unit proof)
Proposal row is durable with pending/approved/denied; a denied pair is never re-raised (dedup across restarts)
capability_run mismatch error text names the amendment proposal path

tasks.title: Plain-language card, CAS catalog amendment, fix-and-continue, e2e proof
tasks.objective: Proposal card via the durable permission-interaction transport: ability-terms body from displayName/can/cannot, widening lead sentence, buttons Approve fix/Deny, technical delta in the full-view diff, sanitizer allowlist. New amendSemanticCapabilityCommandTemplates CAS repo op (templates only, precondition on prior schema, history row + audit link). Approval hook amends then runs the paused-job recheck/resume. Decision 0122 cross-refs.
acceptance_criteria: Card body contains no template strings, argv, ids, or hashes; composed from displayName/can/cannot; widening leads with one plain sentence; buttons read Approve fix / Deny
Technical delta renders via the full-view diff payload (provider-native expandable where supported) and survives the durable-send sanitizer
Approve performs the CAS amendment (commandTemplates only; path/hash/version preserved; concurrent loser gets a clean no-op) with provenance + prior templates in the history row
Approval flows into the existing paused-job recheck/resume; the rerun invokes the CLI through the amended template without re-asking
Integration proof: mismatch -> proposal -> card -> approve -> amended -> resume -> structured run succeeds; denied proposal changes nothing with no second card; hash/path amendment attempt rejected
